included.title: Efficient Exact Unlearning for Federated Zeroth-Order Optimization
included.description_en: Combines seed-encoded ZO training with subsampling/noise stability and replay or rejection-reflection coupling for federated exact unlearning. Experiments include Llama-3.2-1B/3B on TOFU. Proposed updates persistently modify model parameters without backpropagation; exact module coverage and implementation unverified.
included.description_zh: 结合种子编码零阶训练、子采样或噪声稳定性，以及重放或拒绝—反射耦合，实现联邦精确遗忘；TOFU实验包含Llama-3.2-1B/3B。所提更新无需反传且持久改变模型参数；具体模块覆盖与实现待核实。
included.method: 种子编码的函数值零阶更新；子采样与加噪稳定性；训练重放及拒绝—反射耦合。
included.backpropagation: 所提FedZOO-S/NS及对应遗忘更新无需反传；与一阶基线的比较不构成所提算法依赖反传。
included.persistent_parameters: 是，联邦训练与遗忘改变语言模型参数；正文实验确认Llama-3.2-1B/3B，是否全参数及逐模块覆盖待核实。
included.relevance: 高，直接语言模型零阶参数训练及其联邦遗忘系统。
uncertainties: 已核实原始摘要、版本历史、方法概览和实验设置，未阅读全文或复现实验。
精确遗忘为作者在特定算法及假设下的分布性结论，不等同独立验证任意知识完全删除。
可训练模块、代码与会议录用待核实。

included.title: GROM: Gradient-Free Rapid One-Shot Machine Unlearning
included.description_en: Uses forward-pass features and a ridge-regularized least-squares solution to apply a persistent additive weight edit for LM unlearning, principally to MLP down-projections. The edit uses no backpropagation or iterative ZO estimator. Historical backfill; closed-form adaptation, with code, venue and empirical claims not independently verified.
included.description_zh: 从前向特征求解岭正则最小二乘问题，对语言模型施加持久加性权重编辑，主要修改MLP下投影。所提编辑无需反传，也不使用迭代零阶估计器。窗口外补收录，归入闭式适配；代码、录用与实证结论待独立核实。
included.method: 前向特征采集与岭正则最小二乘闭式权重编辑。
included.backpropagation: 所提特征采集与闭式编辑不依赖反传；非迭代函数值零阶优化。
included.persistent_parameters: 是，直接更新MLP下投影权重；正文亦讨论语言模型输出头与注意力输出投影等可编辑矩阵。
included.relevance: 高相关闭式语言模型参数遗忘；单列关联研究，不计作新ES/ZO训练算法。
uncertainties: 已核实原始摘要、版本历史及方法中的可编辑矩阵与闭式目标，未阅读全文或复现实验。
原文提供代码链接，未审查实现；会议录用待核实。
最小二乘局部保持目标不等同对任意输入严格保持，也不能独立保证彻底遗忘。

included.title: Center-of-Mass Interpretation of Evolution Strategies
included.description_en: Interprets the mean-centered ES step geometrically as a scaled shift between the sampled centroid and reward-weighted center of mass. Motivated by ES language-model fine-tuning; theoretical analysis, not a new empirically validated LM training method. No backpropagation in the analyzed ES step; no trained modules reported.
included.description_zh: 将均值中心化ES更新解释为采样质心与奖励加权重心之间的缩放位移，以语言模型ES微调为动机。属于理论解释，未提供新的语言模型训练实证。所分析ES步骤无需反传；未报告实际训练模块。
included.method: 有限种群均值中心化ES更新的几何恒等关系与反向配对采样分析。
included.backpropagation: 分析的ES参数更新不需要反传；论文提供几何解释，未引入新训练实现。
included.persistent_parameters: 理论对象为持久模型参数的ES更新；本文未报告实际训练模型或更新模块，不能统计为新增已实证训练方法。
included.relevance: 中高，正文明确联系语言模型ES微调；作为ES机理分析收录。
uncertainties: 已核实原始摘要、版本历史及正文引言和更新定义，未独立验证全部推导。
几何物理解释需要非负奖励及正总质量；零均值奖励的移位处理与尺度因子应一起理解。
未核实代码或正式录用，不将理论解释写成新增性能提升。

updated.title: Coverage, Not Credit: Failure-Credit Routing of Zeroth-Order Perturbation Budgets Does Not Improve On-Pool Sample Efficiency for LLM Agents

before.title: Coverage, Not Credit: Failure-Credit Routing of Zeroth-Order Perturbation Budgets Does Not Improve On-Pool Sample Efficiency for LLM Agents
before.description_en: Tests whether trajectory-level failure credit should decide how a fixed ZO/ES perturbation budget is split across the modules of tool-using LLM agents (Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B, SmolLM2-1.7B); finds no detectable on-pool gain over uniform allocation and documents failure modes of ZO/ES experiments on frozen LLMs. The exact perturbed parameter set is not stated in the abstract.
before.description_zh: 检验工具调用 LLM agent（Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B、SmolLM2-1.7B）中是否应按轨迹级失败归因在各模块间分配固定的 ZO/ES 扰动预算；在固定任务池上未发现优于均匀分配的可检测增益，并记录了在冻结 LLM 上做 ZO/ES 实验的几类失效模式。摘要未说明具体扰动的参数集合。

after.title: Coverage, Not Credit: Failure-Credit Routing of Zeroth-Order Perturbation Budgets Does Not Improve On-Pool Sample Efficiency for LLM Agents
after.description_en: Studies allocation of ZO/ES perturbation budgets across agent modules. A frozen LM is augmented with 128 checkpointed coefficients, applied through forward hooks to q/v/o projections; mirrored ES trains these persistent adapter coefficients without backpropagation. Authors report no detectable fixed-pool routing gain over uniform allocation.
after.description_zh: 研究智能体模块间的ZO/ES扰动预算分配。冻结语言模型骨干，以前向钩子将128个保存到检查点的系数作用于q/v/o投影，通过镜像ES无反传训练这些持久适配参数。作者报告固定任务池上归因路由未显示优于均匀分配的可检测收益。
after.resources_en: [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.28011) · code not located · 2026-08 / [persistent adapter evidence, section 3](https://arxiv.org/html/2608.28011v1)
